title: Recovery Suit: How Long Do You Have to Sue?
desc: A money recovery suit in Uttarakhand must usually be filed within three years of the debt falling due, under the Limitation Act, 1963, or it becomes time-barred
why: People in Haldwani and Nainital often sit on an unpaid loan or bill for years before deciding to sue, and then find the claim is already time-barred.
keyPoints: Most recovery suits for unpaid money must be filed within three years of the date the amount became due, under the Limitation Act, 1963.
For a loan with no fixed repayment date, the three years run from the day the loan was given, not from when repayment was first demanded.
A signed, written acknowledgment of the debt made before the three years end restarts the clock for another three years.
A part-payment made before the deadline also restarts the three-year period.

sections.h: How long do you have to file a recovery suit?
p: A recovery suit for unpaid money in Uttarakhand must usually be filed within three years of the date the debt became due, under Article 113 of the Schedule to the Limitation Act, 1963, which applies when no other article covers the claim. For money lent on demand, Article 21 sets the same three-year period, but it runs from the day the loan was made. Courts at Haldwani and Nainital can dismiss a suit filed after this period under section 3, even if the other side never raises the delay.

The three years start from when your 'right to sue accrues' — usually the due date on an invoice or cheque, the date fixed for repayment in an agreement, or the day a loan without any fixed date was handed over.

sections.h: Can you get more time if the debtor keeps delaying?
p: Yes, in two common situations. Section 18 of the Act says a fresh three-year period starts if the debtor signs a written acknowledgment of the debt before the earlier period runs out, for example a signed statement of account or a reply admitting the amount owed.

Section 19 does the same when the debtor makes a part-payment of the debt or interest before the deadline. The receipt or bank entry showing that payment becomes important evidence of the new start date.

whatToDo: Note the exact date the money became due — an invoice date, cheque date, or the day a loan was handed over — before deciding when to sue.
If repayment keeps getting delayed, ask for a signed, dated acknowledgment of the amount owed well before three years pass.
Keep every part-payment receipt or bank entry; it can restart the limitation period under section 19.
File the suit in the civil court at Haldwani or Nainital with jurisdiction over the amount claimed, and take legal advice on your own facts if the three years are close to running out.

hi.title: रिकवरी सूट: पैसा वसूलने का मुकदमा कितने साल में करें?
keyPoints: ज्यादातर रिकवरी सूट रकम देय होने की तारीख से तीन साल के भीतर दाखिल करने होते हैं।
बिना तय तारीख वाले कर्ज में यह तीन साल कर्ज दिए जाने के दिन से गिने जाते हैं, मांगने के दिन से नहीं।
तीन साल खत्म होने से पहले कर्जदार का लिखित और हस्ताक्षरित स्वीकृति-पत्र मिलने पर नई तीन साल की अवधि शुरू हो जाती है।
समय सीमा खत्म होने से पहले की गई आंशिक अदायगी से भी यह अवधि फिर से शुरू हो जाती है।
